title: 2021-22 tax apron: decision is to keep the cell blank
detail: Official release https://pr.nba.com/nba-salary-cap-for-2021-22-season-set-at-112-414-million gives cap, tax, minimum team salary and the three MLEs, but no apron (re-fetched 2026-10-22). That alone is enough to keep the cell blank. Hoops Rumors' $143.002M is excluded; according to a search snippet (page not fetched), a Hoops Rumors follow-up comment calls the apron 'trickier to calculate' and is unsure of the math. Reopen only if an official source turns up.
